notes: IMD (src/IMD.sol) is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with no constructor arguments. Its constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 tokens with 18 decimals once to msg.sender. No application contracts or initialization calls are required. pool.initialPrice is provenance only: floor(sqrt(initialMarketCapWei / totalSupply) * 2^96), expressed with IMD as currency0. The deployer derives the actual opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply using the deployed currency ordering.
